local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local old=world:FindFirstChild("UpgradeSigns")
if old then old:Destroy() end
local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="UpgradeSigns";folder.Parent=world

local upgrades={
 {key="SpeedLevel",title="SPEED",icon=">>",sub="+2 Walk Speed",base=15,color=Color3.fromRGB(80,190,255)},
 {key="WorthLevel",title="ENERGY WORTH",icon="x2",sub="+1 Energy / Orb",base=25,color=Color3.fromRGB(255,205,65)},
 {key="AmountLevel",title="ENERGY AMOUNT",icon="+",sub="More Orbs",base=35,color=Color3.fromRGB(105,255,150)}
}
local function cost(d,l) return d.base*(l+1) end

local function makeSign(z,data)
 local x=-21
 local stand=Instance.new("Part");stand.Name=data.key.."Stand";stand.Size=Vector3.new(3,1,8);stand.Position=Vector3.new(x,20.5,z);stand.Anchored=true;stand.Color=Color3.fromRGB(38,43,52);stand.Material=Enum.Material.Slate;stand.Parent=folder
 local post=Instance.new("Part");post.Name=data.key.."Post";post.Size=Vector3.new(1.2,5,1.2);post.Position=Vector3.new(x,23,z);post.Anchored=true;post.Color=Color3.fromRGB(45,50,61);post.Material=Enum.Material.Metal;post.Parent=folder
 local board=Instance.new("Part");board.Name=data.key.."Sign";board.Size=Vector3.new(.8,6.5,9.5);board.Position=Vector3.new(x,27,z);board.Anchored=true;board.Color=Color3.fromRGB(22,27,37);board.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic;board.Parent=folder

 local glow=Instance.new("PointLight");glow.Color=data.color;glow.Brightness=1.2;glow.Range=10;glow.Parent=board

 local gui=Instance.new("SurfaceGui");gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Right;gui.SizingMode=Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud;gui.PixelsPerStud=45;gui.Parent=board
 local bg=Instance.new("Frame");bg.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);bg.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,22,31);bg.BorderSizePixel=0;bg.Parent=gui
 local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke");stroke.Thickness=5;stroke.Color=data.color;stroke.Parent=bg
 local corner=Instance.new("UICorner");corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(.08,0);corner.Parent=bg

 local icon=Instance.new("TextLabel");icon.Position=UDim2.new(.05,0,.07,0);icon.Size=UDim2.new(.9,0,.22,0);icon.BackgroundTransparency=1;icon.Text=data.icon;icon.TextColor3=data.color;icon.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;icon.TextScaled=true;icon.Parent=bg
 local title=Instance.new("TextLabel");title.Position=UDim2.new(.05,0,.30,0);title.Size=UDim2.new(.9,0,.19,0);title.BackgroundTransparency=1;title.Text=data.title;title.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;title.TextScaled=true;title.Parent=bg
 local desc=Instance.new("TextLabel");desc.Position=UDim2.new(.08,0,.50,0);desc.Size=UDim2.new(.84,0,.12,0);desc.BackgroundTransparency=1;desc.Text=data.sub;desc.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(190,200,215);desc.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;desc.TextScaled=true;desc.Parent=bg
 local levelText=Instance.new("TextLabel");levelText.Name="LevelText";levelText.Position=UDim2.new(.08,0,.65,0);levelText.Size=UDim2.new(.84,0,.12,0);levelText.BackgroundTransparency=1;levelText.TextColor3=data.color;levelText.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;levelText.TextScaled=true;levelText.Parent=bg
 local price=Instance.new("TextLabel");price.Name="PriceText";price.Position=UDim2.new(.08,0,.79,0);price.Size=UDim2.new(.84,0,.13,0);price.BackgroundTransparency=1;price.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,230,120);price.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack;price.TextScaled=true;price.Parent=bg

 local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt");prompt.ActionText="BUY UPGRADE";prompt.ObjectText=data.title;prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E;prompt.HoldDuration=.2;prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10;prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false;prompt.Parent=board

 local function refresh(player)
  local level=player:FindFirstChild(data.key);local lv=level and level.Value or 0
  levelText.Text="LEVEL "..lv.."  >  "..(lv+1)
  price.Text=cost(data,lv).." ENERGY"
  prompt.ActionText="BUY - "..cost(data,lv).." ENERGY"
 end
 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
  local energy=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
  local level=player:FindFirstChild(data.key)
  if not energy or not level then return end
  local c=cost(data,level.Value);if energy.Value<c then return end
  energy.Value-=c;level.Value+=1
  if data.key=="SpeedLevel" and player.Character then local h=player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");if h then h.WalkSpeed=16+level.Value*2 end end
  refresh(player)
 end)
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) task.wait(1);refresh(p) end)
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.defer(refresh,p) end
end

makeSign(-11,upgrades[1]);makeSign(0,upgrades[2]);makeSign(11,upgrades[3])
print("Premium upgrade boards loaded")
